first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Star-filled night sky
entities.identification: The blue-cyan star-filled night sky in the upper part of the image, with a broad pinkish-white to pinkish-purple vertical band of light in the center.

entities.name: Lake surface
entities.identification: The blue water surface in the lower-left part of the image, enclosed by mountains, with pinkish-purple and bluish-white reflections across its right half.

entities.name: Ridge encircling the lake
entities.identification: The dark, undulating mountains encircling the lake surface, including the ridgeline and the mountain walls descending toward the lake surface.

entities.name: Foreground rocky slope
entities.identification: The dark-brown to gray-brown steep slope extending from the right side of the image to the lower edge, with rough undulations and light-and-dark grooves on its surface.

entities.name: Evergreen thicket
entities.identification: The dark thicket on the foreground slope and hilltop, with some crowns forming narrow, pointed, overlapping outlines.

entities.name: Foreground dead tree and dead branches
entities.identification: The dark gray-brown leafless trunk and short lateral branches extending into the image from the lower-left edge, with the main trunk slanting toward the upper left.
